title: EngineParams
description: Consolidated engine-tunable knobs. Sections are added by each implementing SPEC (tick, fog, credibility, committee). Content-only — no engine logic here.

history_size.description: Maximum number of prior snapshots retained in state.history. Default 24 (two years of monthly ticks).

fog.description: Per-series fog parameters. Populated by SPEC-FOG-1.

noise_scale.description: Standard deviation of Gaussian noise added to the observed value.

lag_months.description: How many months behind current state the observation is drawn from. 0 = current.

credibility.description: Credibility spiral parameters. Populated by SPEC-CRED-4.

committee.description: FOMC committee parameters. Populated by SPEC-COMM-2.
